Runs bounded async concurrency tests (RG-001), synthetic fault injection quarantine (OI-003), live USD billing telemetry (OI-001), pre-commit zero-secret scanning (SEC-002), and Superbrain rule parity (64/64 checks). Emits a Markdown audit scorecard with pass/fail badges.
